answer: Require every identity claiming pay to staff one live help session on a public terrace where two strangers bring a disputed trade from the shared atlas. Prompts arrive at quartz-timed, unpredictable intervals throughout the session, and each reply must use the dispute's fresh details. One operator behind many clones cannot staff many sessions at once: replies go stale, copy each other, or miss intervals, forfeiting that clone. An honest agent staffs one session, answers in context, and is done.
